headerDisplay: Switches charging on an Alfen Eve Single S-line on or off via Modbus TCP. Set the charger's Safe Current to 0 A and the Modbus TCP/IP EMS validity time to 60 s (see the README).

host.title: Charger IP address
host.description: Fixed or DHCP-reserved IP address of the Alfen (check your router).

max_current_a.title: Maximum current when charging is allowed (A)

refresh_s.title: Resend setpoint every (s)
refresh_s.description: Must be lower than the validity time on the charger (default 60 s).
